messages:
olivia: Quick sync for Nova Labs POC. Goal: chat summarization endpoint with sustained 200 qps, occasional microbursts up to 2k qps (~45-75s). Gen length ~128 tokens, p99 SLO <= 300ms. They want Dedicated with hosted fallback. Need runbook, cost sketch, security checklist, and a reproducible smoke test command we can hand them. When can we run an initial smoke?

kai: Sounds doable. Model choice matters: redwood-1-3b quantized vs 7b. For latency/quality tradeoff recommend starting 3b quantized. We'll validate quality. For perf, 3 shards (A100 class eq) with adaptive batching + prefix KV cache should hit p99 target at 200 qps.

maria: Ops note: do they require multi-AZ? If yes we'll need warm capacity in second region which increases baseline capacity. Also need the exact burst waveform (single spike vs repeated waves) to size request queues and token headroom.

alex-pricing: Preliminary pricing note: Dedicated cost = baseline per-shard hourly + infra premium. Hosted fallback billed per-token during bursts. I can make a simple one-page comparison: monthly vs 6mo commit with discount tiers. Need estimated tokens/sec (qps * avg tokens) to calculate.

olivia: Burst shape: steady 200 qps, but about 10% chance of a 2k qps spike when many users hit summarise concurrently. They prefer monthly to start.

jordan-eng: Technical run plan: 1) Canary ramp 50 -> 200 qps over 10m 2) Two controlled 60s bursts to 2k qps to validate fallback 3) Observe p50/p95/p99 and queue length. With KV caching and batching, 2-3 A100-eq shards should keep p99 < 300ms at steady 200 qps for 3B quantized. If burst sustained, route to hosted fallback.

devops-bot: capacity_hint: dedicated_shards=3; instance=A100-80GB-eq; est_peak_tokens_per_sec=16000; workers_per_shard=4

maria: Short runbook draft: - Monitor queue length and token backlog - If queue > 70% capacity toggle hosted fallback - Alert if p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5% - Rollback: reduce target qps, disable canary, scale down shards. I'll own and expand this playbook.

natalie-sec: Security checklist items: SOC2 alignment, KMS/HSM integration for CMKs, private networking for Dedicated, audit logs, and confirmation on whether PII/PCI will be sent. If PCI is in scope recommend Private deployment. Need customer security questionnaire answered; I'll prep standard responses.

olivia: Can someone paste a compact vegeta (or hey) command we can hand to the customer that is non-invasive and reproducible? Also please attach the pricing snapshot for the call.

kai: Example vegeta target & command to run a smoke at 200 qps for 60s (replace $TOKEN and payload):

```
echo 'POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-1-3b","input":"summarize: <text>","max_tokens":128}' > req.txt
vegeta attack -targets=req.txt -rate=200 -duration=60s | vegeta report
```

Notes: start with -rate=50 then 100 then 200 for safe ramp. For burst tests we run a separate 60s attack at -rate=2000 but only after canary and on-call approvals.

alex-pricing: I'll draft a 1-page: rows = Dedicated baseline (per shard hourly), hosted fallback per-token, estimated monthly spend at steady 200 qps, incremental delta for bursts. Also add commitment pricing row (-15% @6mo). Will share in ~2h.

maria: I'll schedule the POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Kai/jordan please be on the 2k-burst window.

kai: I can join the burst window and help observe client-side metrics.

jordan-eng: I'll watch runtime metrics, KV cache hit rates, and collect kernel-level traces if we see latency regressions.

olivia: Perfect, assembling notes and calendar invite now. I'll attach the vegeta snippet and Alex's pricing sheet to the invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
